images.caption: Figure 1:Specifying the follow-up direction and formulating the scientist’s bar as rubrics make evaluation of open-ended research tractable.(a)For an explicit implementation of the LCHS quantum algorithm[novikau2026efficient], its first author states the direction and the bar.(b)The space of possible follow-upsS1S_{1}is unbounded; fixing the direction narrows it toS2S_{2}, and the scientist’s bar narrows it further toS3S_{3}.(c)Each clause of the bar becomes an item in the direction-specific rubric (yellow) or the integrity rubric (blue). Evaluation checks whether a submission falls inS3S_{3}.

Figure 2:Task formulation ofInto the Unknown. The AI agent is given a task specification, the original paper, along with its code and data. The AI agent should instantiate the scientist’s idea (in the task specification) by submitting a follow-up paper and also provide the code and logs.
